part: Group 9 draft syllabus: Natural Language Processing and Large Language Models
text: The new course Natural Language Processing and Large Language Models is offered to the programmes B.Tech COMP, B.Tech AIML, MBA Tech from the academic year 2027-28. The course modernises the NLP syllabi with fine-tuning and evaluation of large language models.

part: Group 9 draft syllabus: Natural Language Processing and Large Language Models
text: The course carries 4 credits, with 3 lecture hours, 2 practical hours and 0 tutorial hours per week.

part: Group 9 draft syllabus: Natural Language Processing and Large Language Models
text: The prerequisites for this course are: Machine Learning, Python Programming, Probability and Statistics.

section: Unit 1: Text processing and language models
part: Group 9 draft syllabus: Natural Language Processing and Large Language Models
text: Text processing and language models (8 hours). Tokenisation, n-gram models, perplexity.

part: Group 9 draft syllabus: Natural Language Processing and Large Language Models
text: Transformers (10 hours). Self-attention, encoder and decoder models, BERT and GPT.

part: Group 9 draft syllabus: Natural Language Processing and Large Language Models
text: Fine-tuning LLMs (10 hours). Instruction tuning, LoRA and parameter-efficient fine-tuning.

part: Group 9 draft syllabus: Natural Language Processing and Large Language Models
text: The course has lab work: fine-tune a small model with LoRA; build a retrieval-augmented QA system. Lab environment: Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face.

part: Group 9 draft syllabus: Natural Language Processing and Large Language Models
text: How the course is assessed and examined: Internal continuous assessment of 50 marks and a term-end examination of 50 marks.

part: Group 9 draft syllabus: Natural Language Processing and Large Language Models
text: Explain transformer architectures. Fine-tune a language model for a task.
